name: Tulipe
source:
Cursed by your friend, you seek to find a vampire to break the curse tonight. Encountering a mysterious man at a club, you face choices about how far you'll go and how you wish to spend the night with him. 

This queer tale explores themes of asexuality and the longing for platonic connections, with subtext about vampirism.

[From [url=https://dreamty-dream.itch.io/tulipe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
被你的朋友诅咒，你今晚想找到一个吸血鬼来打破诅咒。在俱乐部遇到一位神秘男子，你面临着选择，要走多远，以及如何与他共度良宵。

这个酷儿故事探讨了无性恋的主题和对柏拉图式联系的渴望，潜台词是关于吸血鬼的。

[来自[url=https://dreamty-dream.itch.io/tulipe]itch.io[/url]]
